# Feature: CUT-06b item catalog reads via host (#1160)

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-11-08 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent

Host-only parity for `loadCharacterItemCatalog` and `loadWorldProfileItemCatalog`
(CharacterInventoryV2Panel / WorldItemCatalogSection). Soft-DENY is not success.
Matrix keys: `item-catalog.load-character-catalog`, `item-catalog.load-world-profile-catalog`.

Roadmap: Epic #1135 browser-host cutover — CUT-06b follow-up after CUT-06/#1141.

## Preconditions

- Host auth enabled; InventoryPorts wired
- Actor owns or can read the world profile used for catalog scope
- Feature slug: `cut-06b-item-catalog-reads-host`

## Happy Path

- [ ] `GET /api/v1/library/items?worldProfileId=` returns active catalog for authorized actor (standard + personal + world for that profile)
- [ ] `GET /api/v1/library/items?worldProfileId=&includeArchived=1&origin=world` returns world-only rows including archived
- [ ] `loadCharacterItemCatalog` uses host list with effective worldProfileId (no supabase fallback)
- [ ] `loadWorldProfileItemCatalog` uses host world-scoped list including archived (no supabase fallback)
- [ ] Matrix rows → HOST_VERIFIED with evidence self-test

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Stranger / no ACL on worldProfileId → 403 `not-authorized` (not empty Soft-DENY)
- [ ] Unauthenticated list → 401
- [ ] Missing inventory ports → 503 (fail-closed, not empty list)
- [ ] Catalog rows durable across host restart

## Regression

- [ ] CUT-06 update/archive/restore/fork still green
- [ ] Library item list without filters still returns active personal/standard/readable world

## Assumptions

- Character add-catalog still composes Core/builtin locally; host returns persisted definitions only
- World authoring UI filters archived client-side via existing `showArchived` checkbox

## Security Coverage

- B-01 / SC-01: worldProfileId list authz via `canReadWorldProfile` (IDOR fail-closed)
- B-04: parameterized SQL + LIKE escape unchanged
- Soft-DENY empty catalog when ports missing removed on this route
- Client never sends actor identity; cookie session only
